title: 第二十章 吐真剂第二十一章 人头灯
content_zh:
大皇子的想法，自然跟韩紫枫没关系，她需要的就是尽量的消耗掉，西凉的气运，其他的并不用她关注。别说，她是真认真的杀，霖华仙尊则认真的抽成。
杀着，杀着，紫枫早就从最初的不适宜，到现在的比较习惯，她突然想起一个问题：“等等，你是不是把白莲花的新手礼包给吞啦？”
“叮，补发白莲花系统礼包2。”紫枫直接打开看看，嗯嗯很强大潜能点400。紫枫还发现，白莲花系统虽然是每天都发潜能点，偶尔也会发一些随机的东西，有盖饭、有调理、有药品等等。但都是一般的东西，当然现金也是有的。
她叫比较意外的是，额外还有45点潜能，气运也额外出现加20的样子。她也不多想，平均加也就完事啦。现在后缀已经是筑基期300，紫枫也不多想这个，反到是用灵魂更霖华仙尊交流：“你觉不觉得，这个白莲花系统的功能有点可怜，有点少？话说，你真理解白莲花系统是啥？相当白莲花，演技要到位吧？所以新手礼包，演技是标配。”
“像我这样的刺激版本，是不是应该有额外的奖励，就算碰到真胆小懦弱的，也应该有应急保姆系统吧？嗯，意思是，帮忙出主意，帮忙善后，毕竟，主角掉链子，那就不是白莲花，那就是傻白甜了吧？嗯，任务可以边提意见，边引导善后呗。”
“这样就算真碰上付不起的阿斗，你就叫这个系统，完全当智能AI算啦，就当那个宿主是傀儡就完事啦，也省心不是？再有就是独门绝技。不论什么时代，没一技傍身，就算是再茶，也没啥用的样子。尤其混到男尊女卑的世界，女人更是需要一技之长。”
“对啦，对啦，你完全可以考虑，坑个男人，试试这些奇奇怪怪的系统，毕竟男女的体验感觉，还是差很多的说。毕竟，男人和女人的兴奋，都差很多的样子。”
霖华仙尊很忧伤的来一句：“嗯嗯，用男人实验过啦，平均四五个系统，就一个死给我看的，简直太忧伤啦！”
紫枫很惊悚的问：“你丫干啥啦？不至于这么不抗祸害吧？”
霖华仙尊嫌弃的说：“你当他们多抗祸害？不就叫他们自由发挥吗？然后，意见没多少，集体想不开，死给我看，我也很郁闷啊！”
紫枫偷笑中，她吐槽：“我咋感觉是沟通问题？”她发现，这种打场面作战，剑用着有点不顺手，她问：“亲，能不能把咱仙剑加工下，弄个如意的，我觉得砍人还是刀，斧子，搞起来比较爽的样子。”
霖华仙尊很无语的说：“把剑丢回来，我给你加工下。扣体验点。”果然，钱到位，剩下就是分分钟的事情。剑再次到手，别说想刀，就能变成刀，别说，实验一下，感觉还是刀比较爽。斧子看着就有点，算了总感觉哪里不对的样子。
接下来，紫枫就在霖华仙尊的监视下，愣是玩出猴哥的如意金箍棒的感觉。看着有些玩疯掉的孩子，霖华仙尊也好，大皇子也罢，感觉到的都是满满的忧伤。
霖华仙尊很认真的问：“你这样降维打击，真的好吗？”
紫枫淡定的说：“达到目的就好，凡人这么多，如果你都管，那也太圣母表了吧？问题是，我感觉圣母都不带管这些事情的样子吧？”
霖华仙尊能说啥，算了，看着这个孩子怎么嗨吧。就跟这个孩子说的，凡人，跟他关系并不大，相对的，这个孩子已经做的很好啦。
确定这里的高管贵族已经死差不多啦，后面的事情大皇子那边应该就能善后啦，想到这里紫枫也就直接瞬移去军营这边，既然知道这里镇守的自己二哥，她也就不客气，直接出现在军营的中。
问题就比较尴尬了，这里坐镇的两个人，她完全不认识的说，她疑惑问：“你们谁啊？”看着他们身上的军装什么的，应该是大凛的军装没错，那么上官擎这个家伙呢？
其中一个看起来，棱角分明的人说：“我是这里的将军，你是？”
紫枫更加疑惑啦：“贵姓？”

这个男人大言不惭的回答：“上官擎。”
紫枫点头，歪头看着另外一边的男人，男人回答：“胡勤岚。”
紫枫也不惯着，上去就把两人打晕，随后，瞬移返回，别说，满朝文武真都没走呢，紫枫疑惑：“咋都没走呢？”
皇帝指着土特产说：“你这边人头滚滚的，我们这里等支援。”
紫枫回答：“西凉皇城那边，大皇子安排处理后续。老爹，看看，这是二哥？咋大变活人了，你先研究着，我再去抓一个叫胡勤岚的去。”说完就消失，抓着胡勤岚再次回来。
两人醒的还是比较快的，紫枫也懒得更他们废话，直接咨询系统：“亲，有霍格沃茨，斯内普老师的吐真药剂不？批发！”
很快系统就给出价格，别说，真心不算贵，2体验点，居然给了一大箱子，保守里面有上万瓶。系统还贴心的一句：“亲，凡人一次半瓶就好了，保证有用。”
紫枫也不多想了，掰开两人嘴，一人惯半瓶，然后就直接问第一个抓过来的：“上官擎呢？”
那个人回答大概的意思就是，上官擎现在，在胡家做客，这个人是胡家五子，甚至接管了上官擎的兵符。紫枫问：“你们胡家和西凉那边，有什么交易？”
叫所有人都有些惊悚的，不但上官家的虎军，被胡家人渗透的千疮百孔，就算边境几成，都快被西凉人渗透的没法要了。
紫枫一摊手说：“我尽力啦，这个我真没招，你们研究，我去下一家啦。”
接着返回，问清楚大皇子都处理妥当，紫枫再次拉着他，直接去北蛮浪，依旧是什么都不想，杀就完事啦。只是嗯，当看到古墓一样的地方，紫枫很是无语，不过，好在，之前更那群盗墓的混的也挺熟的，于是，她开心的抓壮丁。
content_en:
The eldest prince's thoughts naturally have nothing to do with Han Zifeng. What she needs is to consume Xiliang's luck as much as possible, and she doesn't need to pay attention to other things. Needless to say, she was really serious about killing, while Immortal Linhua was serious about taking the commission.
Killing, killing, Zifeng has gone from being unfit at first to becoming more accustomed to it now. She suddenly thought of a question: "Wait a minute, did you swallow White Lotus's novice gift bag?"
"Ding, reissue the White Lotus System Gift Pack 2." Zifeng opened it directly and took a look. Yes, it's very powerful, with 400 potential points. Zifeng also discovered that although the White Lotus system releases potential points every day, it occasionally releases some random things, including rice bowls, conditioning, medicines, etc. But they are all ordinary things, and of course there is cash.
What was surprising to her was that there was an additional 45 points of potential, and an additional 20 points in luck. She didn't think much about it, just added the average and that was it. Now that the suffix is already at the foundation stage of 300, Zifeng didn't think much about it. Instead, he used his soul to communicate with Linhua Immortal: "Don't you think that the functions of this White Lotus system are a bit pitiful and a bit lacking? By the way, do you really understand what the White Lotus system is? It's quite White Lotus, and your acting skills must be on point, right? So in the novice gift package, acting skills are standard."
"Should an exciting version like me have extra rewards? Even if you encounter someone who is really timid and cowardly, there should be an emergency nanny system, right? Well, it means to help give ideas and help with the aftermath. After all, if the protagonist fails, then it is not White Lotus, then it is Silly Baitian, right? Well, during the task, you can give advice and guide the aftermath."
"In this way, even if you really encounter Adou who can't afford it, just call this system and treat it completely as an intelligent AI, and just treat the host as a puppet. It's worry-free, right? And then there is the unique skill. No matter what era, if you don't have a skill, even tea is useless. Especially in a world where men are superior to women, women need special skills."
"Yes, yes, you can consider tricking a man and trying these weird systems. After all, the experience of men and women is still very different. After all, the excitement of men and women is very different."
Immortal Linhua said very sadly: "Yeah, I have tried it on men. There are four or five systems on average, and only one of them died for me. It's so sad!"
Zifeng asked in horror: "What are you doing? You're not so irresistible to harm, are you?"
Immortal Linhua said disgustedly: "Do you think they are more resistant to harm? Why don't you just let them express themselves freely? Then, there are not many opinions, and the collective can't think about it. If you die to me, I am also very depressed!"
While Zifeng was snickering, she complained: "I feel like it's a communication problem?" She found that it was a bit awkward to use the sword in this kind of situational combat. She asked: "Dear, can you process our fairy sword to make it as desired? I think it's more fun to kill people with a knife or an axe."
Immortal Linhua said speechlessly: "Throw the sword back and I'll process it for you. Experience points will be deducted." Sure enough, the money is in place, and the rest is a matter of minutes. The sword is in hand again. Don't even think about the sword, it can become a sword. Don't worry, after experimenting, it feels better to use the knife. The ax looks a little bit like, forget it, it always feels like something is wrong.
Next, under the supervision of Immortal Linhua, Zifeng was stunned to play with Brother Monkey's Ruyi Golden Cudgel. Looking at some children who are playing crazy, whether it is Linhua Immortal Lord or the eldest prince, all they feel is full of sadness.
Immortal Linhua asked seriously: "Is it really good for you to reduce the dimensionality like this?"
Zifeng said calmly: "As long as you achieve your goal, there are so many mortals. If you care about them all, wouldn't it be too much for the Holy Mother? The problem is, I feel that the Holy Mother doesn't care about these things, right?"
What can Immortal Linhua say? Forget it, just watch how this kid gets excited. Just tell this kid,Mortals have little to do with him. On the contrary, this child has done very well.
It was determined that the high-ranking nobles here were almost dead, and the eldest prince should be able to deal with the aftermath. Thinking of this, Zifeng teleported directly to the military camp. Since she knew that her second brother was guarding here, she was not polite and appeared directly in the military camp.
The question was more embarrassing. She didn't know the two people sitting here at all. She asked confusedly: "Who are you?" Looking at the military uniforms they were wearing, they should be Dalin's military uniforms, but what about this guy Shangguan Qing?
One of the angular-looking men said, "I'm the general here, are you?"
Zifeng became even more confused: "What's your surname?"
The man replied confidently: "Shangguan Qing."
Zifeng nodded, tilted her head and looked at the man on the other side. The man replied: "Hu Qinlan."
Zifeng was not used to it. He went up and knocked the two of them unconscious, and then teleported back. Not to mention, all the civil and military officials in the court didn't leave. Zifeng was confused: "Why didn't they leave?"
The emperor pointed to the local specialties and said: "Your side is full of people. We are waiting for support here."
Zifeng replied: "Over in Xiliang Imperial City, the eldest prince arranged to handle the follow-up. Dad, look, is this the second brother? Why did he become a living person? You study it first, and then I will catch someone named Hu Qinlan." After saying that, he disappeared and came back again holding Hu Qinlan.
The two of them woke up relatively quickly. Zifeng was too lazy to talk nonsense to them and directly consulted the system: "Dear, do you have Hogwarts, Mr. Snape's truth potion? Wholesale!"
The system quickly gave the price, which was not expensive at all. For 2 experience points, I was actually given a large box, which contained tens of thousands of bottles. The system also said thoughtfully: "Dear, just take half a bottle at a time. It is guaranteed to be useful."
Zifeng didn't think too much, opened their mouths, and each of them used half the bottle, and then directly asked the first one to catch him: "Where is Shangguan Qing?"
The man's answer probably meant that Shangguan Qing was now a guest in the Hu family. This man was the fifth son of the Hu family and even took over Shangguan Qing's military talisman. Zifeng asked: "What's the deal between your Hu family and Xiliang?"
Everyone was a little bit frightened. Not only the Shangguan family's Tiger Army, but also the Hu family's infiltration was riddled with holes. Even if the border was a few percent, it was almost completely infiltrated by the Xiliang people.
Zifeng spread his hands and said, "I'm trying my best, but I really can't do this. You can study it, and I'll go to the next one."
Then he returned and asked the eldest prince if everything was done properly. Zifeng took him again and went directly to Beimanlang. He still didn't think about anything and just killed him. It's just that, when she saw a place like an ancient tomb, Zifeng was speechless. However, fortunately, the group of tomb robbers from before were also quite familiar with each other, so she happily caught the strong man.
